item.title: Lacuna 0.4.0
item.description:
Fill multiple brace phrases in order. Lacuna starts with the earliest phrase, highlights the active one, and shows your progress in the suggestion popup. Accepting an option starts the next request using your updated wording as context. Escape stops the sequence without changing the remaining phrases.
Restores highlights in Chrome rich-text inputs that expose text positions only through their text nodes. Opening-brace highlights no longer depend on optional line metadata, and valid highlights survive slow or incomplete accessibility responses.
Highlights appear immediately when reopened and track window movement more closely.

item.title: Lacuna 0.3.1
item.description:
Highlights now follow brace expressions across wrapped lines and explicit line breaks, including the Try Lacuna editor. Each visible line gets its own outline, without covering unrelated text between line fragments.
Highlights also stay within the visible text field when scrolling. Regression checks cover resizing, long expressions, Unicode, and both macOS text layout engines.

item.title: Lacuna 0.3.0
item.description:
Lacuna can now update itself.
Choose Check for Updates… in the menu to download and install new releases, then relaunch automatically. You can also opt into automatic background checks from the menu.
Updates preserve settings and Keychain entries. Both the update feed and downloaded archives are verified with Lacuna's update-signing key.
This is the first version with an updater. Versions 0.2.x need one manual installation to get it.
